title: Leading Frontend Architecture
description: Led the frontend architecture for developer tools and AI-powered features at Vercel.
challenge: Building scalable frontend infrastructure that could handle millions of developers using the platform daily, while maintaining performance and supporting cutting-edge AI features.
solution: Architected a modular component system with server-side rendering, implemented progressive enhancement patterns, and created a robust state management solution that scales across the entire platform.
results: 30% improvement in page load times across the platform
Reduced bundle size by 45% through code splitting and lazy loading
Enabled 15+ AI-powered features with seamless integration
Improved developer experience with better error handling and accessibility

title: Building Performant Project Management
description: Built performant interfaces for project management and team collaboration.
challenge: Creating a responsive UI that handles real-time updates for thousands of issues while maintaining smooth animations and interactions.
solution: Implemented optimistic updates, virtual scrolling for large lists, and used Framer Motion for performant animations. Built a custom state synchronization layer for real-time collaboration.
results: Support for 10,000+ concurrent issues without performance degradation
Real-time collaboration features that felt instantaneous

title: Payment Infrastructure Development
description: Developed payment infrastructure and merchant-facing dashboard features.
challenge: Building secure, PCI-compliant interfaces for handling sensitive payment data while providing an intuitive experience for merchants.
solution: Created secure tokenized payment forms, built a comprehensive merchant dashboard with analytics, and implemented robust error handling for payment failures.

title: Optimizing Booking Experience
description: Created booking flow optimizations and host management tools.
challenge: Streamlining the booking process to reduce friction while ensuring hosts had powerful tools to manage their properties.
solution: Redesigned the booking flow with smart defaults and one-click checkout, built an intuitive host dashboard with property management and analytics.
results: Reduced booking flow steps from 7 to 4
